name: vscode-asciidoc-preview-style
description: Applies Light 2026 colors to AsciiDoc Preview (Asciidoctor VS Code) in every workspace, independent of the VS Code theme.

commands.title: AsciiDoc Preview Style: Restore (remove from user settings)

enumDescriptions: Apply the Asciidoctor VS Code 4.3.0 workaround (sets the user-level asciidoc.preview.style to a generated bundle).
Do not manage asciidoc.preview.style; remove the value this extension set. Only the asciidoc.previewStyles contribution remains.
asciidocPreviewStyle.mode.markdownDescription: How the Light 2026 style is applied. Asciidoctor VS Code 4.3.0 does not load styles contributed through `asciidoc.previewStyles`, so `auto` writes a bundle (standard CSS + Light 2026) and points the user-level `asciidoc.preview.style` at it.
